constant_boundary_comparison: constant 1 maps to sqrt(r_theta); these are distinct reference preparations/readouts in the common representation.
covariant_boundary_comparison: take both boundary vectors r_theta^(-1/2) in L2(nu_theta); the amplitude equals the nu_0 constant-boundary amplitude exactly.
disclosure: Added after the original plan was frozen and its calculation launched. No fixed witness parameters or error orders changed. This is a disclosed interpretation and control supplement, not preregistered.
family_equivalence: nu_theta and nu_0 are mutually absolutely continuous for every theta in [-1,1].
new_claim_boundary: The witness rejects invariance of the constant-boundary reference prescription. It does not establish physically inequivalent predictions after transport of the same preparation and readout.
purpose: Distinguish altered reference preparation/readout from a unitary representation change of the same state.
